Class AssetManager

java.lang.Object
application.AssetManager
public final class AssetManager extends Object
Singleton image repository that preloads and serves game asset textures.

    • loadAsset

      private void loadAsset(String assetPath)
      Loads a single image asset from the given path and stores it in the images map. Prints an error to standard error stream if the resource is missing or invalid.
      Parameters:
      assetPath - The relative path of the image asset to load.

    • buildAssetList

      private static List<String> buildAssetList()
      Helper method to build a unified list of all assets that need to be preloaded.
      Returns:
      An unmodifiable list containing all asset paths.

    • getImage

      public javafx.scene.image.Image getImage(String name)
      Looks up a preloaded image by asset key.

      Expected key format matches project-relative resource paths such as Environment/Grass/spr_grass_01.png.

      Parameters:
      name - asset key used during preload
      Returns:
      image for the key, or null when no image is available
